about_the_game:
Build an underground city filled with bearded blacksmiths and glittering gemstones with the KR Dwarf Kingdom Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has crafted a set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to help you create stone towns, cozy rooms, and sprawling tunnels all carved out of the center of mountains or deep underground. 2 A1 sheets, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are full of stone, metal, and wooden tiles that can build rich dwarven mansions, dirt-filled mines, giant barrels that act as tiny bedrooms, and more! Make a small mountainside village with blue tile roofs and metal pipes connecting every building that acts as the entrance to a monster-filled cavern, or build a city inside a volcano with lava pooling around the edges and massive metal chains hooked onto the edges of the buildings to make sure they don’t fall into the fiery lake. Create unique inns where every room is built in an oversized wooden barrel, or keep things simple with mine tracks that weave between stalagmites and lead to colorful jewels stuck into jagged stone walls.

This pack also includes 16 character images for objects to add extra business to your mines! Light tunnels with flickering flames and have mine carts rolling around the tracks filled with jewels to show that the mine is still active even with monsters roaming around. Power the underground village with large wooden waterwheels and gears spinning on the sides of buildings, and reward your players for searching alleys with a barrel-shaped treasure chest. Sample maps for MV and MZ are also included to help inspire you and figure out the tileset passability, just in case you’re not sure what will work best. If your game includes dwarven cities or you want to build some dark caves that reveal an ancient civilization, pick up the KR Dwarf Kingdom Tileset!


The Dwarf Kingdom Tileset Includes:

Ground tiles:

water
lava
grass and dirt (matches Everyday Town)
plain colored floors - tan, brown, blue and darker blue
marble floors - tan, maroon and blye
rough stone floor
cavern floor (lightly textured)
metal panels
mushrooms
table
fancy edges (for use with floor tiles)
and more!

Walls/roofs:

Walls to match floors, mine walls, metal panel walls. Also includes versions of walls lit by lava.

Also includes:

Stairs to match floors
elegant arches and pillars
simple staircases
bridge edges (use any floor tile with these) plus support structures to run beneath
fantasy mining equipment - 5 colors of jewels, in several shapes, and also loaded into buckets, mine carts and other containers, picks, mine supports, ropes and pulleys to carry buckets across gaps
ropes and ladders for climbing and crossing gaps
lanterns, lit and unlit
large sections of cavern walls to give more variety
cavern arches and pillars
cave doors with rock edges
stalagtites and stalagmites
huge chain...layer up the links to make them as long as you want!
dwarf sculptures to embed in rock faces
barrels large enough to enter - includes alternate empty and water-filled versions in several sizes. Use for houses, utilities and more! Includes lit and dark windows/doors.
pipes, random machinery, animated gears
blue roof sections for more design options
ivory design details - roof edges, windows, random details and more
blacksmith shop - forge, tools, sample items like swords, axes, shields and armor
interior furniture - beds of two types, shelves with decorative and functional items, tables, chairs, cabinets, kitchen goods, matching stove and more!

Events and Animations:

pulley and bucket animations, with jewels
fire animation
forge-light animation
gears, large and small
smoke for chimneys
barrel that opens to hide treasure inside
valve handles
water wheels
mine carts with jewels
doors (metal, ivory with decoration, mine door) with lit, dark and transparent versions


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
